description: A live SVG badge and an iframe widget for a stake pool, DRep or token: the URLs, Markdown and HTML to paste into a README, a website or a forum post. Checks that the subject exists.

color.description: Badge colour: green, yellow, red, blue, orange, grey, brand, or 3 or 6 hex digits. Default: the colour the figure earns.

id.description: Pool id (pool1… or 56 hex), DRep id (drep1… or 56 hex) or token unit (policy id + asset name in hex).

label.description: Replaces the left-hand text of the badge (printable ASCII, at most 30 characters).

metric.description: What the badge shows. Pool: return, luck, blocks, saturation, stake, delegators, pool. DRep: votes, participation, power, delegators, drep. Token: price, price-ada, change, token. Default: the identity badge (pool, drep or token).

style.description: Badge style: flat, flat-square or for-the-badge.

subject.description: What the badge is about: pool, drep or token.

theme.description: Theme of the iframe widget: dark, light or auto.

name: get_embed_snippet
title: Badge and widget snippet
